test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error.

If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Mohan is still confused about his higher studies.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is no grammatical error in the sentence "Mohan is still confused about his higher studies."
 
• The sentence is correctly structured. "Still" is properly used to indicate that the confusion persists, and "confused about his higher studies" is an accurate expression.
 
• Thus, there is no error in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mohan is still confused about his higher studies."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Mohan is still" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "his higher studies" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "confused about" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
